rules.title: City of Hoboken algorithmic rent-fixing ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords renting residential units in Hoboken may not use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing landlords.
rules.citation: City of Hoboken outlaws algorithmic rent-fixing (City Council meeting of July 9, 2025)
rules.status_basis: Page states the City Council adopted the legislation at its July 9 meeting (2025); ordinance number and effective date not given.

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords renting residential units in Hoboken.

rules.quoted_span: It will now be illegal for landlords renting residential units in Hoboken to engage in price-fixing through algorithmic rent-fixing, meaning they can no longer use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing landlords.
